annotations.text:
Toasts — sileo restyled to the VizServe design system.

Every value here is lifted from app/globals.css: Figtree, --radius-xl (14px), the status triples, --elev-2/--elev-3, --hl.

Direction B (Panel) is chosen. The action button is filled with the variant's solid — white ink in light (5.2–6.5:1), near-black in dark (5.5–7.8:1), because white on the dark solids measures 2.2–3.1 and fails.

The axis: does a toast read as a PANEL (our overlay language — popover fill, hairline border, lit top edge, status only in the badge) or as a CAPSULE (sileo's own identity — tinted surface, coloured text, pill)?

A is louder and less like the rest of the app. B is quieter and matches every other overlay.
